description: LIFE MAP defaults (design: LIFE-STAGE-DESIGN-2026-11-16.md). Edit freely; 'variants' are named partial overrides for comparing decisions.

stages.name: Starting out
stages.line: Building the first cushion and the first habits.

stages.name: Building
stages.line: Saving steadily and protecting the people who rely on you.

stages.name: Peak years
stages.line: Your strongest earning years. The plan gets real numbers.

stages.name: Final approach
stages.line: Five years or fewer to go. Turning savings into income.

stages.name: Early retirement
stages.line: Living on savings before the later-life rules begin.

stages.name: Later years
stages.line: Keeping income steady, planning for care, making things easy to hand over.

safety.why: Nothing else holds without a cushion; later it is a habit to keep, not to build.

protect.why: Matters most while others depend on a pay cheque; fades when savings can carry the household.

handover.why: Grows with what there is to hand over and with age; never fades.

grow.why: The saving habit and the employer match early, upkeep later.

independence.why: The goal becomes concrete within about 15 years of it, and is done once work stops.

income.why: Only meaningful once withdrawals are near.

taxes.why: The biggest choices sit between stopping work and required withdrawals.

health.why: Cover before Medicare, then the cost of care.

education.why: Own loans early, children's costs mid-life; switched by the modifiers.

modifiers.why: Others depend on the income; guardianship matters.
Years without employer cover or penalty-free access.

windows.source: Open enrolment for 2027 coverage: HealthCare.gov 1 Nov to 15 Dec; state exchanges may run to 31 Dec (federal Marketplace Integrity and Affordability rule; secondary source, checked by Cowork 2026-11-17, medium-high confidence)
Calendar-year filers: the tax year ends 31 Dec (401(k) deferrals must be made through payroll by then); checked by Cowork 2026-11-17

IRA and HSA contributions for a tax year are due by the filing deadline, 15 Apr of the next year; an extension does not move it (taxact.com important tax dates; checked by Cowork 2026-11-17, high confidence)
